pages.title: Autumn Rosary
pages.text:
An alternating series folds seventy roots into a five-petaled bloom, its coefficients swelling and contracting through a logarithmic breath with period five. The unit circle sweeps the parameters; the reversal mirror doubles the symmetry. Around the central flower, a broken rosary of amber droplets traces the orbit where clustering roots catch the spectral autumn light.

poly_150 · degree 70 · 1000×1000 · clusteriness · spectral autumn · Aberth-Ehrlich

pages.title: Solar Reliquary
pages.text:
Twenty-two hand-wrought coefficients climb through ascending powers, each folded with sine, cosine, and the logarithmic shadow of the parameters. At degree seventy, the roots compress into a gilded sphere ribbed with fine radial teeth, split by a violet meridian where conjugate symmetry breaks. Filaments of scattered light radiate outward — the outliers, roots that escaped the gravitational center, glowing brightest in the inferno palette where deviation from the median is greatest.

poly_160 · degree 70 · 5000×5000 · outlierness · inferno · Aberth-Ehrlich (parallel)
